custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hinge mechanism. In AI images, moving parts like hinges often fuse together or lack necessary gaps/screws. Also, scrutinize the plastic texture; real plastic usually has subtle imperfections or flow lines from manufacturing, whereas AI plastic often looks uniformly smooth or waxy. Determine if the deviation from the 'metal/cylindrical' taxonomy prior is a valid variation (plastic loupes exist) or a sign of generative confusion.
